notes.title: Build 0.2.5
notes.content:
[b]New Content[/b]

- 10 new Prestige upgrades

- New Ship based Upgrades

- Ability to filter the Hiring pool by increasing the minimum tier and selecting worker jobs you do not want to generate.

- Added Sound effects to a few locations and a Sound effect mute button (volume controls to come soon)

- Added more Background music and gave dungeon types their own themes.

[b]Bugfixes[/b]

- Fixed issue with upgrading worker weapon skill

- Additional tweaks to Shift system 

- Fixed issue with some timers not initializing on new game

notes.title: Minor Hotfix 0.2.4.1a
notes.content: Fixed bug causing the tutorial to crash and repeat "Mister" over and over.

notes.title: Build 0.2.4.1
notes.content:
[b]New Content
[/b]
- Added a new world map screen the the Adventures menu 

[b]Bugfixes[/b]

- Fixed an issue with Shifts not re-assigning workers intelligently if the Bench would be full.

notes.title: Build 0.2.3.3
notes.content:
[b]Minor Changes
[/b]
- 2 new Prestige upgrades have been added that allow you to start new runs with your adventurers given default base level items

- Loot animation in the Dungeon menu improved

- Loot labels have been changed in the Dungeon menu, you can now see their drop rates and explanations by mousing over them

- Monthly relic drop rates have been increased by 2.5x so that its much less likely to miss one with casual play. 

- Tier 1 resources have had their initial production rate increased to speed along the early game on an entirely fresh run

- Monthly relic items now have additional properties, and proper names/descriptions. 

[b]Bugfixes
[/b]
- Fixed a few minor calculation errors, mostly to do with rounding

- Some Incorrect/Ambigious text has been rewritten

- Automatic Error reporting functionality improved.

- An issue that could cause a save to not load has been fixed

notes.title: Hotfix Build 0.2.3.2
notes.content: Fixed a bug that could cause employee identifiers to reset to 0, leading to weird behavior within the shift system

notes.title: Build 0.2.3
notes.content:
[b]Major Changes[/b]

- The Party system has now been added. You can now pre-define groups of adventurers for quicker adventure allocation, or even set pre defined dungeons to automatically run.

[b]Minor Changes[/b]

- Added the ability to limit leaderboard records to friends only or completely opt out through the Options menu.

- Added 2 more Loadout slots

[b]Bugfixes[/b]

- Fixed the Item design weapon power estimation not accounting for Item mod choices.

- Fixed a CTD that could fire in extremely specific circumstances

- Fixed some Z-fighting issues with menus 

- Fixed an issue inflating Leaderboard records when de-encrypting them back to BigNum values from the steam API to display

notes.title: Build 0.2.2.0.2
notes.content:
[b]Minor Changes[/b]

- Leaderboards for Achievements and prestige counts have been added. For now, they will only update on retirement. 

Bugfixes

- The Avatar customization modal was not pulling in your avatar sprite, and Avatar specializations were defaulting to sword on retirement. This has been fixed.

- The leaderboard was not pulling in the scores around you correctly if you were not in the top 20. This has been fixed.

- Knowledge leaderboard scores were being posted even if you have 0 

- The Avatar modal changes inadvertently gave all employees the tag that prevents them from being fired. This has been fixed, you are now free to fire your poor workers right before the holidays, you monsters. 

-The re-done Sidebar on the title screen was overlaying the save import window

- A CTD that could occur in rare circumstances has been fixed.

notes.title: Hotfix Patch 0.2.2.0.1
notes.content: The Friends leaderboard was pulling from the global pool, not your friends list. This has been fixed.

notes.title: Patch 0.2.2, "I'm really not dead, guys" edition.
notes.content:
[b]Major Changes [/b]
[list]
[*]The Steam integration layer has been redone. Steam Achievements are now earnable. I'll be slowly adding most of the existing ones to the Steam
There is now an experimental leaderboard for the most total knowledge earned where you can see how you rank globally and between your friends. Your rank on the leaderboard will never provide a mechanical advantage, its just for fun, its not meant for FOMO. I will also likely not be particularly proactive with culling non obvious cheaters, so don't stress it too much. Depending on the reception and any potential issues arising form it, it might go away or be limited to your friends list.  I will also be adding more leaderboard categories once I am sure there are no major structural issues with the system.
[*]Promoted employees can now learn new skills up to what their rank allows through a gacha system, you do not have to accept the result, but approval is final for now.  (cont)
You can now upgrade and customize your main avatar character through the employee screen. The changes will not take place until retirement, but you can change your focused weapon, boost base stats, and equip new passives. This system is very likely to change as we go.
 [/list]
[b]Minor Changes[/b]
[list]
[*]The hireable Employee roster pool now will now empty out between sessions and will require a refresh. Once the Employee save code rewrite is done to reduce the amount of save space an employee takes up, the pool will be maintained from session to session.
[*]A side menu has been added to the title screen to switch between your friend-leaderboard and the current patch notes.
[*]Unity version and that of some libraries has been updated. This may cause issues, though automated testing hasnt caught any.
[/list]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
[list]
[*] Auto upgrade tooltip was showing 0 left regardless of auto upgrades available, it is now showing the correct amount
[*] Chapter 2 was showing Chapter 3's text
[/list]

notes.title: Build 0.2.1c
notes.content:
[b]Minor Changes:
[/b]- You can now rename your avatar character and change it's portrait and gender from the Settings page (Some settings probably reset)
- You can now use custom avatar images (Images must be PNGs at least 512x512 stored in your (\Documents\My Games\Idle Weaponshop\Custom Avatars) folder 
- A introductory tutorial walkthrough has been added, up to designing your first item so far
- The Story tab has been added to the Records Menu. If you've been dying for genre fiction written by a STEM major, you're in luck!


[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Some Pixel scaling was not setting properly 
- Resolution tab in the Settings page was defaulting to the highest resolution regardless of setting
- Hourglass label was wrong
- Hourglass generation was off due to being on a 90 sec timer instead of a 60 sec one.
- The game Quit button and game resolution options was showing for the WebGL version when it should only be showing on Windows builds

notes.title: Build 0.2.1b
notes.content:
[b]Minor Changes:
[/b]- Resolution and fullscreen settings should now persist through playthroughs. You will need to change them one more time to make sure they save.
- Pixel art assets/icons that were scaling up poorly will now maintain their original size through resolution changes
- Minor cosmetic facelift to Adventurer detail menu
- Change to Explorer dungeon trait to explain how Explorer league exp is gained.
- Gold preview for blueprints now accounts for mods
- A quit button has been added to the interface for players playing in full screen


[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Employee Haulers were not resetting their values on levelup leading to them scaling to ludicrous levels quickly, allowing for nearly instant material commissions.
- New Relic indicators were not working, and notification for earned relics was not firing from relics earned on offline time
- Rebirth qualification percentage was not showing as a percentage

notes.title: Build 0.2.1a
notes.content:
[b]Minor Changes:[/b]
- New items have been added to the animation panels in the Current Job and Dungeon Menus
- 2 new Prestige upgrades have been added

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Item display choices should persist through prestiges
- Druids being able to roll other classes' traits has been fixed
- Haulers should now properly increase the max speed of finishing material contracts

notes.title: Build 0.2.1
notes.content:
[b]New Content:[/b]
- Tier 2 Blueprints and Adventurers have been enabled. You may already have found their unlock relics, but you will also need to purchase a prestige upgrade to use them
- A new Dungeon has been added, the Boundless Frontier. This dungeon has it's own special mechanic, in that traversing it levels a new Building, the Explorer's  League. This building has no associated tools, nor does it provide a bonus other than converting levels earned this run into permanent experience. But as the Explorer's league gains permanent levels, you will eventually unlock new dungeons, materials, and improvements to the dungeon itself.
- Additional milestones have been added 
- Additional Prestige upgrades have been added. There are no remaining (NYI) tagged upgrades
- Steel and Faewood have been added as the new highest tier materials. But you will also have to unlock some of their materials.
- Druids and Dwarven Smelters have been added as new class types.

[b]Minor Changes:
[/b]- Enchantment bonuses from employees and upgrades has been soft capped at 100% bonus per enchant stage. You were unlikely to hit this previously.
- Hiring lists are now sorted by quality 
- Icons denoting the mods and enchanting strategy of weapon jobs in the current job screen have been added
- A popup will now warn you when you attempt to purchase a prestige upgrade that costs a significant chunk of your knowledge. This can be toggled off.



[b]Bug fixes[/b]
- Contracts and Refining stopping because they were pulling from your previous run's material count until one relogs has been fixed.
- Weekly relic issues have been fixed.
- Pasted Jobs sharing a single mod pool has been fixed.

notes.title: Build 0.2 Update
notes.content:
[b]New Content:[/b]
- A new Commission system where you can take out contracts to provide permament upgrades has been added and can be unlocked from the Retirement tree at  1 million reputation

[b]Minor Changes:[/b]
- The Retirement button now shows at all times and will either show you how close you are to unlocking it, or how many points you can earn currently.
- You will now unlock an additional bench slot for every active worker slot you earn.

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- A minor fix to daily dungeon relic drops being off by a weekday

notes.title: Build 0.12a
notes.content:
[b]Minor Changes:
[/b]- Pause button for jobs has been added
- A new Retirement upgrade that boosts the  Minimum tier of hireable employees has been added

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Bug changing the required amount of items to perform weapon mods has been fixed
- Bug where Dungeon speed talents were working but not showing their effects on the GUI has been fixed
- Bug where some Dungeon loot was not showing as earned on restart
- Bug where unlocked employee types weren't being reset on retirement has been fixed
- Bug where Daily dungeon wasn't generating on prestige has been fixed

notes.title: Build 0.12
notes.content:
[b]Content Changes:
[/b]- New Weapon mods have been added that take new resources. Unlock these via dungeon exploration
- New worker traits that unlock for worker generation when the relevant content is unlocked

[b]Misc changes:
[/b]- Blueprint refining levels now show on the blueprint menu
- An additional resolution option has been added
- Dungeon relic listed drop rates now take into account building bonuses on the tooltip (the actual drop rate didn't change)

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
- Dungeon completion achievements will now trigger
- Refinement loadouts were not being saved through new instances of the game
- Dungeon achievements were not being unlocked on clear properly
- Fixed Employee traits that scale with level not properly adjusting for employee level on tooltip
- Misc String fixes

notes.title: Build 0.11c - 3/10/2024
notes.content:
[b]Minor Changes:
[/b]- The Percentage to roll duplicate worker class penalty has been greatly lowered
- A new prestige upgrade has been added that will increase weapon power gain

[b]Bug fixes:
[/b]- Fixed a few graphical bugs that changing displays broke
- Fixed issue with some prestige upgrades requiring relog to apply
- Fixed bug where item mods were not being saved on new craft
- Fixed  few incorrect strings

notes.title: Build 0.11b
notes.content:
[b]Minor Changes:[/b]
A tips menu has been added to the bottom of the screen to give some pointers for progression.
Newly found relics will now be highlighted in the Relic menu.

[b]Bug fixes:[/b]
Several numbers in-game were incorrectly truncating decimal points, this has been fixed.
Bug fix to incorrect gold cost for quickbuying material rate upgrades
Bug fix to blueprint base value amount in item design page (it was including the cost of the mandatory materials)
Fixed missing adventurer skills on Tooltip
Fixed Mahogany unlock upgrade being labelled "Bars" instead of Planks.
Fixed Employee refresh timer requiring a game refresh to start working

notes.title: Daily update - 2/29/204
notes.content:
- Fixed a bug where Daily Dungeon and the Weapon dungeon were being unlocked by default when generating.

- Removed some debug code

- Added Beta notice window for new players.

- Fixed a few smaller bugs
